title: Exploring the underlying structure of mental disorders: cross-diagnostic differences and similarities from a network perspective using both a top-down and a bottom-up approach
limitations: - Data were originally collected for other research questions (secondary analysis); - Diagnostic groups are heterogeneous; - Only five specific mental states were included; - Statistical comparison of networks was not possible due to lack of methods.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the main text, but the authors thank participants and data collectors in the acknowledgements, suggesting data may be available upon request. The paper is a secondary analysis of pooled ESM data.
